page.layout: One page of text. Central bordered list: years in the left margin, names in the box, one italic marginal note at the top right. Running head at top, page number at top right.

l.note: Celebre fœdus Groning. cum vicinis in agro.

page.notes: The 1368 entry has no names printed beside it; its line is blank inside the box. The word "Maurissing" is printed with the long s written as a double f-like form (ff ligature shape); transcribed here with plain s per the long-s rule. The bullet-like specks after "Albert Calmar." (1370) and near "Iidem sex." are ink spots, not text. Name spellings (Herman/Harmen, Gerdt/Geert) differ between entries and are copied as printed. The final "Iidem" is set at the right of the box bottom. The bottom-right "Google" watermark and the small mark at the foot centre are digitiser/scan marks and are omitted.
